name: skills-cookbook
description: Ready-to-paste example prompts that teach efficient use of the hub's skills across five tracks: project understanding (cognitive-load reduction), feedback and quality loops, product, marketing, and design/frontend. Ships combination recipes plus an anti-pattern matrix of mutually exclusive or redundant skills. Use when the user asks for example prompts, how to use a skill, which skills to combine, or how to understand a project with less cognitive load.
